Expenditure Minimization and Duality

Achieving target utility as cheaply as possible — the tangency of isocost lines and the indifference curve. Turn on the "UMP mirror" and the utility-maximizing bundle at w=e(p,u)w = e(p, u)w=e(p,u) lands exactly on Hicksian demand. That coincidence is duality.
